summary: 工具使用、发明和策略性欺骗显示，鸟类认知能力远超传统想象。文章以取食工具和群居鸟类为例，分别讨论觅食竞争与复杂社交如何推动智力演化。

paragraphs.brief: 重新审视沿袭已久的看法。
sentences: For centuries, many scholars maintained that humans were the only intelligent organisms on Earth.
几个世纪以来，许多学者都认为人类是地球上唯一的智能生物。
Many traits were considered to be exclusively human examples of acumen – for example, language, tool use, deception, and awareness of self and others.
许多特征被认为是人类独有的敏锐范例，例如语言、工具使用、欺骗和自我意识和其他意识。
However, exciting new research on a number of animals, particularly birds, has called into question the uniqueness of these traits, forcing us to reconsider this opinion.
然而，关于一些动物，特别是鸟类的令人振奋的新研究使人们对这些特性的独特性提出质疑，迫使我们重新考虑这一看法。
In 1964, people were amazed when naturalist Jane Goodall first discovered chimpanzees making and using tools.
1964年，当自然主义者简·古多尔首次发现黑猩猩制造和使用工具时，人们感到惊讶。
But ornithologists, people who study birds, were not overly surprised.
但鸟类学家研究鸟类的人并不感到过度惊讶
Almost 20 years earlier, a renowned ornithologist had shown that tool use was commonplace in populations of woodpecker finches residing on the Galápagos Islands.
近20年前，一位著名的鸟类学家表明，在居住在加拉帕戈斯群岛的木鸟群中，使用工具是司空见惯的。
These tiny birds routinely used twigs to extract grubs from under bark.
这些小鸟通常用树枝从树皮下提取小虾。

paragraphs.brief: 几种鸟使用工具的例子。
sentences: Since then, the catalogue of tool-using animals has grown.
从那时起，使用工具的动物目录有了增加。

At least three Australian bird species make tools similar to those of the woodpecker finch, and when white-winged choughs come across shellfish, they have been known to use rocks as hammers to crack open the recalcitrant shells.
至少有三个澳大利亚鸟类制造的工具类似于木鸟的石器，当白翼的爪子遇到贝类时，他们以石头作为锤子来敲开坚硬的贝壳。
Other birds show a more sophisticated level of insight.
其它鸟类的洞察力更先进
For example, black kites have been reported dropping bait into lakes to bring fish to the surface of the water, thereby making them easier to catch.
例如，据报告，黑风筝向湖泊投下诱饵，将鱼带到水面，从而使鱼更容易捕获。
A kite may also pick up a smouldering stick from an area recently burned by a bushfire and drop the stick on a patch of unburned grass.
风筝也可以从最近被灌木丛烧毁的地区捡起一根烟雾棒，把棍子扔在一片未燃烧的草地上。
The bird then feasts on the small animals that flee from the subsequent fire.
鸟儿然后吃小动物逃离随后的火。

paragraphs.brief: 鸟类使用工具的能力与生存之间的联系。
sentences: Most tool-using behaviours are a means of extracting food, which may provide a clue as to how the mental abilities needed for tool use evolved.
多数使用工具的行为是提取食物的手段，这可能为工具使用所需的心理能力的演变提供线索。
The predominant explanation is based on the proverb that ‘necessity is the mother of invention’.
主要的解释是基于一句谚语，即`必要性是发明之母 '。
Essentially, brain tissue is energetically expensive, so animals should have evolved only the intellectual capabilities required to overcome the challenges they face in their environment.
基本上，大脑组织是精力昂贵的，所以动物应该已经进化了所需的智力能力来克服他们在环境中面临的挑战。
Consider a hypothetical duck grazing on a seemingly endless supply of grass.
假设是鸭子在似乎无尽的草地上放牧
Being particularly intelligent will not help the duck eat more grass.
聪明一点也帮不了鸭子吃更多的草
In contrast, other species, such as birds of prey, live in a more challenging environment, where food may be distributed erratically, hidden from view or highly mobile.
相反，其他物种，如猎物鸟类，则生活在更具挑战性的环境中，食物分布不规律、隐蔽或流动性强。
The food itself may be quite intelligent.
食物本身可能相当聪明。
So, if there are not enough resources to feed all individuals, then only the smartest in each generation will live and reproduce.
因此，如果没有足够的资源来喂饱所有个人，那么，每一代人中只有最聪明的人才能生存和繁殖。

paragraphs.brief: 同一种鸟使用多种工具的技巧。
sentences: New Caledonian crows boast many different tools in their toolkit.
新喀里多尼亚乌鸦在工具箱中吹嘘着许多不同的工具。
They use a hooked tool made by removing all but one of the side branches from a twig.
他们用一种工具，除掉树枝以外的所有树枝。
They fashion serrated rakes (using their beaks as scissors) from stiff, leathery pandanus leaves.
他们从僵硬的皮质板叶上制成折叠的红毛(用嘴作为剪刀)
They also make probes by modifying their own moulted feathers.
他们也通过改变自己的软羽毛来进行探针。
Each tool is used in slightly different ways to pull grubs from deep within tree trunks.
每种工具都以略微不同的方式用于从树干深处拉出粪便。
The crows carry their favourite tool from one foraging site to the next.
乌鸦把最喜欢的工具从一个觅食地点带到另一个地点
They also store their tools for later reuse in a secure place on their perch.
他们还将工具储存起来，以后再用在水坑上的安全的地方。
Problem-solving abilities have traditionally been thought to be beyond the reach of animals.
解决问题的能力传统上被认为是动物无法掌握的。
Nevertheless, birds are coming up with innovative solutions all the time.
然而，鸟类总是会提出创新的解决办法。
Recently, New Caledonian crows were observed moulding a piece of wire, something they had never seen before, into a hook and then using it to retrieve food.
最近，新喀里多尼亚的乌鸦被观察到在铸造一条铁丝网，这是他们以前从未见过的，然后用它来取回食物。

paragraphs.brief: 支持鸟类智力的生理证据。
sentences: Literally hundreds of such reports have accumulated in back copies of scientific journals.
实际上，已有数百份这类报告在科学期刊的后印本中积累。

Recently, a team of biologists from McGill University in Canada collated them and compared the frequency and size of innovations with the size of the birds’ forebrain (the brain area responsible for higher-order information processing) relative to the hindbrain.
最近，加拿大麦吉尔大学的一组生物学家整理了它们，比较了创新的频率和规模与鸟类前脑的大小(负责较高级信息处理的大脑区域)与后脑的大小。

The team uncovered a clear relationship: birds with relatively large forebrains are able to invent fresh solutions to ecological challenges, and to exploit the discoveries and inventions of others, more often than birds with relatively small forebrains.
团队发现了一种明显的关系：具有相对大的前脑的鸟类能够发明出应对生态挑战的新办法，并比相对较小的前脑鸟类更经常地利用他人的发现和发明。

paragraphs.brief: 把认知能力与群居生活联系起来的理论。
sentences: Intelligence in birds may also arise as a result of selection to overcome the dynamic challenges of communal living.
鸟类的情报也可能是选择克服社区生活的动态挑战的结果。
Since this involves competition between group members, to be successful a social animal may need to be able to reflect on its own intentions, as well as those of others.
由于这涉及集团成员之间的竞争，要取得成功，社会动物也许需要能够反思其自身以及他人的意图。
The consequence of being part of a community may be the evolution of a distinctly ‘political’ brain.
成为社区成员的后果可能是明显意义上的`政治 ' 大脑的演变。
What better way to exercise a political brain than to be deceitful!
还有什么比欺骗更好的方法来行使政治头脑？
Perhaps the best example of deception among birds comes from the white-winged choughs.
也许鸟儿之间欺骗的最好例子来自于白翼的爪子
Choughs are cooperative breeders – that is, they form a communal group consisting of one breeding pair and up to 15 non-breeding ‘helpers’.
Choughs是合作育种者，也就是他们组成一个社区团体，由一对育种夫妇和15个非育种“帮手”组成。
However, because young choughs have so little enthusiasm for foraging, or gathering food, they are often too hungry to help.
然而，由于年轻的小黑猩猩对觅食或收集食物的热情很小，他们往往太饥饿，不能提供帮助。
And because it is socially unacceptable to be part of a group and provide little help, young choughs often act deceptively.
并且因为作为群体的一部分和提供很少的帮助是社会不能接受的，年轻的爪牙往往采取欺骗行为。
For example, when an adult is watching, a young chough will place some food in the mouth of a hungry chick but not release it.
例如，当成年人在看的时候，一只年轻的猎犬会把一些食物放进一个饥饿的小鸡的嘴里，但不会释放出来。
Instead, it waits until the adult departs and then eats the food itself.
相反，它会等到成年人离开，然后自己吃食物。
A chough can also help the group by preening the chicks.
一只小猎犬也可以通过给小鸡们做装饰来帮助它们。
Interestingly, it is more likely to preen the chicks if another bird can see it do so.
有趣的是，如果另一只鸟能看到它，它更可能给小鸡做预感。

A chough that has been sitting totally still on the nest while the rest of the group is foraging out of sight will comically spring up and frantically start to preen the chicks as soon as some of its group members come into view.
一只一直坐在巢里其余的一群人正在失去视线时却一直坐在巢里会令人可笑地浮出水面疯狂地开始催眠小鸡
It is likely that these young choughs are only motivated to help when others are watching because they are concerned about their social status.
这些年轻的猎人可能只是因为关心自己的社会地位而有帮助的动机。
Choughs need other choughs to like them, as they cannot breed without them.
Choughs需要其他的爪子来喜欢他们，因为没有它们，他们无法繁殖。

points: 包括鸟类在内的观察证据，动摇了只有人类才会制造和使用工具的旧观念。
题干问“利用食物来吸引猎物”。定位句写到“例如，据报告，黑风筝向湖泊投下诱饵，将鱼带到水面，从而使鱼更容易捕获”。
clauses: “that humans were the only intelligent organisms on Earth”补足 maintained 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 maintained 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
So, …, then only the smartest in each generation will live and reproduce.
连接词 if 引出“if there are not enough resources to feed all individuals”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: Many people are aware of the intelligence of chimpanzees and other mammals.
很多人都知道黑猩猩和其他哺乳动物的智力。
However, birds also demonstrate intelligent behaviour.
然而，鸟类也表现出聪明的行为。
